## Finance Data Aggregator (Workflow 1)
Called by the Next.js dashboard via GET /api/dashboard. Reads all 4 tabs of the Finance OS Google Sheet in one batch call, computes every metric in the Code node, and responds with DashboardData JSON.

Rule: ALL financial math lives in the Code node. The AI (OpenAI) never computes numbers.
